title: Maxx Crosby: Vegas is a different type of city, we have to earn home-field advantage

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Maxx Crosby: Vegas is a different type of city, we have to earn home-field advantage
sources.description: "We're new to this city and we have to win. The fans come out, they want to see a winner. We have to earn that," Crosby said.
